subject: Cost & Performance — implementation itinerary and test plan
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@nimbus.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus — cost/perf tuning kickoff

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We move fast and want to make sure the first phase of integration focuses squarely on token cost and p95 latency while we roll out chat to our customer support flow. Two asks to start:

1) A concrete implementation itinerary with owners and checkpoints (we need dates we can put into our Sprint).
2) A minimal test matrix you recommend (batch sizes, cache warmup, quantization profiles to validate) so our infra team can allocate perf windows.

High level constraints: 8k prompt+KV typical, 3–5 concurrent inference workers from our side, avg target p95 <= 400ms, cost target <= $0.015/token (ballpark). We can share sample logs.

Can you send an itinerary and proposed acceptance criteria? Prefer a short working session Wed or Thu next week.

Thanks —
Priya
VP Product
Nimbus.ai


From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus — cost/perf tuning kickoff

Priya —

Appreciate the clarity. I pulled together a focused implementation itinerary (attached) that maps the perf work to short checkpoints we can run in parallel with your integration. Summary here so it's easy to paste into your sprint plan: 

- Week 0 (Kickoff): mutual action plan review, SSO and network checklist, sample traffic + schema. Owner: Aditya
- Week 1 (Bench & Baseline): load a representative model variant, run baseline with 1/4/8 batch sizes, capture raw token cost and p95. Owner: Karthik
- Week 2 (Caching & Prefix KV tests): enable prefix/KV caching on a dev pool, run warmup scenarios (0/1/3 requests warmup), measure cache hit rates and p95 impact. Owner: Marissa
- Week 3 (Quantization Validation): smoke test quant profiles (fp16, int8, 4-bit quant) on a subset of prompts; evaluate quality delta using a 200-prompt golden set. Owner: Karthik
- Week 4 (Routing + Canary): create routing policy (latency-first vs cost-first) and run canary traffic split; rollback criteria defined. Owner: Aditya/Marissa
- Week 5 (Cutover & Postmortem): cutover plan, final perf/cost report, and knob list for production. Owner: Aditya

Acceptance criteria (proposed): p95 <= 400ms on the chosen route OR documented tradeoff where cost reduces >20% and p95 <= 550ms with fallback to latency route on regressions. Quality: human-eval on golden set shows <= 2% drop in top-line accuracy when using selected quant profile.

Test matrix highlights in itinerary (attached): batch sizes to try (1,4,16), cache warmup steps (0,1,3), quant profiles (fp16, int8, q4), and routing splits (90/10, 50/50). We also call out metrics to capture: token_count, cost_per_token, p50/p95/p99 latency, cache_hit_rate, and quality_score.

Proposed working session: Wed 09/22 10:00–10:45 PT or Thu 09/23 14:00–14:45 PT. Which works?

Attachment: nimbus_onboarding_itinerary.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Best,
Aditya Rao
Implementation Lead — Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbus.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus — cost/perf tuning kickoff

Adding a few practicals from the CS side so the bench is actionable: 

- Golden prompt set: I attached a starter CSV (200 prompts) — please flag any PII or proprietary prompts. We'll use that for quant smoke tests and regression checks.
- Quality thresholds: define one primary metric (answer correctness) and two secondary (hallucination rate, token efficiency). We'll codify the exact checks in the Week 3 test harness.
- Data collection: please share a 48–72 hour sample of normalized request traces (timestamps, prompt_len, response_len, model_variant). We need this to synthesize realistic concurrency.
- Routing policies: recommend implementing three policy templates: latency-first (default), cost-aware (lower-cost model variants with monitoring), and emergency-fallback (always route to highest-SLA model). We'll test the 90/10 and 50/50 splits in Week 4.

On owners: Karthik will lead quant validation and help size GPU instances; I will own caching experiments and the canary rollout. Aditya will coordinate the final cutover.

Attachment: golden_prompt_set.csv (CSV, 14KB)

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Thanks — that looks good and actionable. We can do Wed 09/22 10:00 PT. I will: 

- Share a 72-hour anonymized request trace (we'll scrub PII) by EOD tomorrow (attached).
- Confirm the golden prompts (we have a few support templates to add).
- Prep our infra folks to be on the call for benchmarking windows.

Two quick clarifications: 
1) For quant testing, do you expect any model re-training or only offline evaluation against the golden set?
2) For routing, can you outline the rollback signal that would automatically revert traffic from cost-aware to latency-first? (e.g., sustained p95 > 600ms for >5 minutes or error rate delta > 0.5%)

We will upload the sample logs to the Drive link and accept the calendar invite when it hits.

Attachment: sample_traffic_logs.jsonl (JSONL, 1.2MB)

—Priya
VP Product, Nimbus.ai
